# eleazarbensimon.github.io

> This origin hosts Bakshi&Bitton — a structured, source-linked documentary record of Israeli Supreme Court rulings on elected-branch decisions and appointments. Every case in the record is a real, docketed case and links to the official court file.

## Start here

- [Full machine-readable site guide](https://eleazarbensimon.github.io/bakshi-and-bitton/llms.txt): the complete index of cases, explainers and datasets, with citation rules.
- [Site](https://eleazarbensimon.github.io/bakshi-and-bitton/): the record itself, Hebrew-primary.
- [Sitemap](https://eleazarbensimon.github.io/bakshi-and-bitton/sitemap.xml)
